title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 117 West Poythress Street in Hopewell, Virginia, as the Reverend Curtis West Harris Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 117 West Poythress Street in Hopewell, Virginia, as the "Reverend Curtis West Harris Post Office Building."

summary.headline: A 2020 law renamed the Hopewell, Virginia, Postal Service building after Reverend Curtis West Harris.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives an official name to a U.S. Postal Service building at 117 West Poythress Street in Hopewell, Virginia. The building will be called the Reverend Curtis West Harris Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2020, and the name applies from that date.
